'''Darth Azamin''' was a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> of [[Human/Legends|Human]] or [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] descent<ref name="Species" /> who served as a member of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] ruling [[Dark Council]] and the head of the [[Sphere of Military Strategy]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Near the end of the war<ref name="Darth Decimus" /> in [[3653 BBY]], Azamin's fellow Councilor [[Darth Vowrawn]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Decimus]] arranged for a [[Jedi strike team (Assassination of Darth Azamin)|strike team]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to infiltrate [[Darth Azamin's stronghold|Azamin's stronghold]] and [[Assassination of Darth Azamin|assassinate]] the Dark Councilor. The Jedi were successful in their attempt, though they were [[Death/Legends|killed]] when Decimus arranged the explosion of their escape craft. Azamin's death allowed Decimus to ascend to the Dark Council,<ref name="Darth Decimus" /> and the Sith Lord took over the Sphere of Military Strategy<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> for the remainder of the Great Galactic War and the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Darth Decimus" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Azamin was first mentioned in the Codex entry for Darth Decimus in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Darth Decimus" />
